storyImages.chartAlt: Sky chart showing catalog star positions around {{name}}
storyImages.targetNotice: The center marker is this story's object. This is a chart of catalog star positions in a {{field}}° field, not a photograph. It does not show the object's true size or its appearance through a telescope.
storyImages.constellationNotice: This chart shows catalog star positions and the constellation's connecting lines. It is not a photograph. The lines help identify the pattern; they are not physical lines between stars.
storyImages.orientation: North is up and east is left. J2000 equatorial positions use stereographic projection. The pattern can appear rotated in the sky depending on time and viewing direction.
storyImages.chartCredit: Coordinates and lines, redrawn as a chart:
storyImages.sharedNotice: This photograph contains both NGC 869 and NGC 884. It shows the whole Double Cluster in Perseus, rather than a close-up of just the cluster in this story.
